title: Origin story: Prometheus
description: Prometheus was a Titan, son of Iapetus, whose name means forethought. He shaped mankind from earth and water and, when Zeus withheld fire from mortals, stole it from Olympus hidden in a fennel stalk. For this Zeus chained him to a Caucasus cliff where an eagle devoured his regenerating liver each day.

title: Stamina feats: Prometheus
